name: pii-remover
description: PII auto-masking/restoration plugin for OpenCode and Claude Code

scripts.build:plugins: bun run --filter '@pii-remover/opencode-plugin' build && bun run --filter '@pii-remover/proxy' build && bun run --filter '@pii-remover/cli' build && bun run --filter '@pii-remover/vision' build && bun run --filter '@pii-remover/mcp-server' build
scripts.build: bun run build:core && bun run build:plugins
scripts.typecheck: bun run build:core && bun run --filter '@pii-remover/core' typecheck && bun run --filter '@pii-remover/opencode-plugin' typecheck && bun run --filter '@pii-remover/proxy' typecheck && bun run --filter '@pii-remover/cli' typecheck && bun run --filter '@pii-remover/vision' typecheck && bun run --filter '@pii-remover/mcp-server' typecheck
scripts.gen-vectors: bun scripts/gen-token-vectors.ts && bun scripts/gen-restore-vectors.ts && bun scripts/gen-stream-vectors.ts && bun scripts/gen-sse-vectors.ts && bun scripts/gen-provider-vectors.ts && bun scripts/gen-router-vectors.ts
